subject.title: [Bug]: delivery-recovery 0 recovered / N failed after gateway restart — recovery starts before channel transport ready

question: Should Feishu pending delivery recovery be solved with a Feishu reconnect drain, a generic channel-ready recovery gate, or by requiring more live proof before selecting the contract?
rationale: The source shows the remaining gap, but choosing the long-term recovery contract affects channel lifecycle semantics and retry behavior across restarts.

options.title: Add Feishu Reconnect Drain
options.body: Implement the existing channel-owned reconnect-drain pattern in Feishu first, with live restart proof and focused tests.

options.title: Design Generic Ready Gate
options.body: Move startup delivery recovery behind a shared channel-ready contract so all channels participate consistently, at higher implementation cost.

options.title: Require Live Proof First
options.body: Keep the item open but defer code until a maintainer or reporter captures a live Feishu restart reproduction.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Reconnect Drain
recommendation.body: Implement the existing channel-owned reconnect-drain pattern in Feishu first, with live restart proof and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the maintainer-side automerge signal for the scoped fix that explicitly left the remaining policy open.
